Start date: 1704-08-29  
20 weeks = 140 days.  
Add 5 days → total 145 days.  
1704 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 rule for Gregorian).  
From Aug 29:  
Aug has 31 days → remaining in Aug: 2 days (Aug 30, 31).  
145 − 2 = 143 days left.  
Sep (30) → 143 − 30 = 113  
Oct (31) → 113 − 31 = 82  
Nov (30) → 82 − 30 = 52  
Dec (31) → 52 − 31 = 21  
Jan 1705 (31) → 21 − 31 = −10 → means Jan 1705, day 31 − 10 = 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1705-01-21
